facts.statement: The genus Shixinggia was named after Shixing County in Guangdong, China, where its fossils were found.
facts.quote: Shixinggia is a genus of oviraptorosaurian dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous period of Shixing County, Guangdong, China, for which it was named.

facts.statement: Fossils of Shixinggia were discovered in Shixing County, Guangdong province, China.
facts.quote: Sus restos fueron encontrados en el condado de Shixing, provincia de Guangdong, China.

facts.statement: No skull has been recovered for Shixinggia, but the species is known from a significant amount of post-cranial material.
facts.quote: While no skull was recovered, the specimen (BVP-112) is known from a fair amount of post-cranial material

facts.statement: Shixinggia measured approximately 1.50 meters in length.
Lü and colleagues described the Shixinggia specimen as an oviraptorosaur, noting it could potentially be a caenagnathid.
facts.quote: Lü et al. describió al espécimen del Shixinggia como un ovirraptórido, pudiendo tratarse de un cenagnátido.

facts.statement: Shixinggia is classified within the parent group Heyuanninae.
Shixinggia belongs to the family Oviraptoridae.
Shixinggia lived during the Late Cretaceous, approximately 70 million years ago in the Maastrichtian stage.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 70 millones de años, en el Maastrichtiense

facts.statement: The time range for Shixinggia is estimated from 72.2 to 66 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Maastrichtian to Maastrichtian (72.2 to 66 million years ago)

facts.statement: Along with the more advanced Heyuannia, Shixinggia is one of the few oviraptorosaurs discovered in China.
facts.quote: junto con el más avanzado Heyuannia, Shixinggia es uno de los pocos ovirraptorosaurianos descubiertos en China.

facts.statement: The authority for the genus Shixinggia is Lu & Zhang, 2005.
